description: This file defines the UserMigrationService class responsible for migrating users' calendar synchronization data from a legacy GoogleSync system to a new CalendarSync system within SuiteCRM. It includes methods to validate system requirements, find users needing migration, perform the migration steps including creating OAuth connections and calendar accounts, and handle related OAuth token validation and refresh.

classes.name: UserMigrationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for migrating users from an old GoogleSync system to the new CalendarSync system, handling OAuth connections, calendar accounts, and legacy sync status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes dependencies such as database manager, logger, and OAuth service.

methods.name: validateUserMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the required modules and database tables exist for migration.

methods.name: findAllUsersForMigration
methods.description: Retrieves all users requiring calendar sync migration, both legacy and new system users.

methods.name: findLegacyGoogleSyncUsers
methods.description: Finds users with legacy Google Calendar sync configuration.

methods.name: getUserBean
methods.description: Retrieves a user bean by ID with validation.

methods.name: extractLegacyUserData
methods.description: Extracts legacy Google sync data and tokens from a user bean.

methods.name: findNewGoogleSyncUsers
methods.description: Finds users with existing Google Calendar accounts configured in the new system.

methods.name: migrateUser
methods.description: Migrates a single user, creating OAuth connection, calendar account, and disabling legacy sync, with error handling.

methods.name: hasNewGoogleCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if a user already has a Google Calendar account in the new system.

methods.name: createOAuthConnection
methods.description: Creates and saves an OAuth connection bean for a user and validates/refreshes tokens as needed.

methods.name: validateAndRefreshOAuthConnection
methods.description: Validates OAuth token occupancy, refreshes tokens if expired, or throws errors.

methods.name: createCalendarAccount
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccount bean and links it to the OAuth connection.

methods.name: disableLegacySync
methods.description: Disables legacy Google sync preferences for a user.

methods.name: createEmptyUserData
methods.description: Constructs an empty legacy user data object for new sync users.

methods.name: createOAuthBean
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth connection bean.

methods.name: createCalendarBean
methods.description: Creates a new Calendar account bean.
